title: Cardinal Billing Account Rules Manual: Reinstatement After Cancellation for Nonpayment
content:
## Section 5. Reinstatement

5.1 A policy cancelled for nonpayment can be reinstated through its Cardinal Billing Account.

5.2 **Window.** Reinstatement is available only when the reinstatement payment is received no later than the pay plan's reinstatement window days (calendar days) after the cancellation effective date of the policy. The window is counted in calendar days from the cancellation effective date, that date being day 0, and a payment posted on the last day of the window is in time. The cancellation effective date is the one on the company's record of the auto policy, read before the reinstatement.

5.3 **Reinstatement payment.** The reinstatement payment is the full past-due amount at cancellation plus the pay plan's reinstatement fee; the return premium credited at cancellation is reversed by the reinstatement.

5.4 **Lapse.** When the payment posts no later than the pay plan's without-lapse days after the cancellation effective date, coverage is restored with no lapse. Otherwise coverage is restored from the reinstatement date with a lapse from the cancellation effective date.

5.5 **No-loss statement.** Where the pay plan requires a no-loss statement, the named insured must first sign a statement that no accident or loss occurred during the lapse; a reinstatement with a lapse is processed only when the signed no-loss statement is on file. The statement is on file when the reinstatement request on record stands as statement signed. A named insured who reports a loss during the lapse cannot sign the statement, and the account is not reinstated.

5.6 **Limits.** No reinstatement is processed once the term has had the pay plan's maximum reinstatements per term (counting reinstatements of the account during the current term), nor after the term expiration date, nor for an account whose cancellation followed a returned reinstatement payment in the same term.

## Window and lapse, both sides (hypothetical plan with a 20-day window and 3 without-lapse days; cancellation effective date is day 0)

| Posting day of the reinstatement payment | Within the window | Lapse |
|---|---|---|
| Day 3 | Yes | No lapse |
| Day 4 | Yes | Lapse from day 0; signed no-loss statement must be on file |
| Day 20 | Yes, the last day is in time | Lapse; signed no-loss statement must be on file |
| Day 21 | No | Reinstatement not available |

## Reinstatement payment (hypothetical)

The full past-due amount at cancellation was $186.40 and the plan's reinstatement fee is $25.00: the reinstatement payment is $211.40.
